title: A failed git stash create fell through to HEAD with status 0, so a build could drop uncommitted edits
resolution: source_revision returns on a failed stash or rev-parse and both callers exit; a test checks that no build starts.

title: A clean tree built the ref HEAD, resolved again per step, so a commit between the two builds compared two revisions
resolution: source_revision resolves the commit ID once with git rev-parse --verify HEAD; a test moves HEAD during the first build.

title: The cleanup trap hid a failed removal of the check's images
resolution: finish_reproducible reports a failed removal, fails a check that passed, and keeps a failed build's status; two tests cover it.

title: The requirement and doc claimed one image ID with the build cache, though a cached COPY layer keeps older file times
resolution: The requirement, its scenario, the doc, and the design cover builds without the cache; cached builds are a recorded limitation.

title: The requirement promised one ID on any Docker engine, though only the classic image store was measured
resolution: The requirement and its scenario name the classic image store.

title: The Dockerfile test fixed its stage list, so a new unclamped stage of the worker passed
resolution: The test derives the stage chain of worker from FROM and COPY --from; an added unclamped stage now fails it.

title: The spec and doc said make verify checks the clamp of changed times, though it checks the suffix
resolution: The requirement, scenario, and doc say each RUN ends with the clamp to SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH.

title: The Dockerfile comment said each RUN clamps, though the harnesses stage does not
resolution: The comment names the stages of the worker image.

title: The commit time was read inside the build arguments, so a failed git log went unnoticed and the check read it twice
resolution: Each caller reads the commit time once, exits on failure, and passes it; a test checks that no build starts.

title: The harness variant build was not run with Docker after the change
resolution: make qualify-harnesses for linux/amd64 ran on the clean tree of 5dc42b19 and passed; the record names its image.

title: The proposal's scripts and tests entries missed the pass 1 changes
resolution: The entries describe the resolved commit, the stop on errors, and every new test.

title: The file comparison came from a prototype build on the base, not the final Dockerfile
resolution: Repeated at 5dc42b19 against the old Dockerfile on the same context; the sizes are given per image after pass 3, unreviewed.

title: The repeated comparison gave the two Dockerfile sizes in the old image's order after naming the new image first
resolution: The self-check gives each Dockerfile size and image size with its image.
